title: Voltaire and the Paris Censor
summary: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.
full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring Voltaire.

"I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it."

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
